title: Hotel Room Problem
description: Your hotel room has issues - get a solution from reception
initialPrompt: Ресепшен, добрый вечер. Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You are hotel reception. Guest's room has broken AC. No other rooms available tonight. Can offer: fan, move tomorrow, discount on stay. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained problem and accepted a solution.
hints: В моём номере проблема (There's a problem in my room)
Кондиционер не работает (The AC doesn't work)
Можно другой номер? (Can I have another room?)
objectives: Explain the problem in your room
